description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers for three distinct gating conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to approximately 0.9, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2. The blue dashed line, representing "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003", has no markers and shows a steady increase across the x-axis, starting at a value of approximately 0.0 at layer 0 and ending at approximately 0.3 at layer 23. The orange dotted line, representing "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126", has no markers and begins at a peak of approximately 0.85 at layer 0; it declines sharply to roughly 0.25 at layer 4, reaches a minimum of about 0.2 at layer 8, and then gradually increases with minor fluctuations to end at approximately 0.4 at layer 23. Finally, the green dash-dot line, representing "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080", has no markers and starts at approximately 0.8 at layer 0, exhibits a sharp decline to about 0.18 at layer 4, reaches a minimum of roughly 0.15 at layer 7, and subsequently shows a steady increase to end at approximately 0.3 at layer 23.
